headline: Allegion (NYSE:ALLE): A Quality Dividend Stock with Sustainable Growth and Strong Fundamentals
summary: Allegion Plc offers a sustainable 1.39% dividend with 9.79% annual growth, strong profitability, and solid financial health, making it a quality dividend stock.
